description: Use this whenever a new file/folder is created or renamed in this Vue project, when reviewing a module for consistency, or when the right path for a file is unclear. Also triggers on "what should I name this?", "is this file named correctly?", "audit module naming". Enforces kebab-case folders, dot-prefixed `{module}.{name}.{type}.vue|js` files, multi-entity rules, singular vs plural for views, and the layered structure UI → Store → API.
